_demo: DEMO DATA — not real bookmarks. Synthetic rows whose only job is to exercise the ingest contract and give the explorer something to navigate locally. Every xPostId is prefixed `demo-` and every authorHandle starts with `demo_` so these can never be mistaken for captured bookmarks. Delete with: MATCH (b:Bookmark) WHERE b.xPostId STARTS WITH 'demo-' DETACH DELETE b
